reuseBasis: Public United States Census Bureau geographic reference data (United States government work, 17 USC 105); retain attribution. No provider listing or service fact is imported.
scope: 2025 ZCTA internal reference points, not USPS delivery validation, legal boundaries, addresses, service coordinates, service coverage, or live availability.
selection: All ZCTA codes with first three digits 010 through 029 (priority Massachusetts/Rhode Island search area), plus ZCTA codes explicitly present after a state code in current United States catalog addresses.
precision: Published internal reference point; approximate area only. Search radius is an explicit visitor choice of 10, 25 or 50 km. It never creates a directions action.
countryChoice: A five-digit input does not silently select the United States. The visitor must choose the labeled US ZIP area action.
unsupported: Unincluded postcodes remain literal/unsupported. Ask for city, region and country without geolocation or external query lookup.
maintenance: Download the source separately, run node scripts/build-postal-areas.mjs <downloaded-text> <candidate.js>, review the source hash/diff and then publish the reviewed candidate. Builds never fetch it. Parsing/schema/scale errors leave the previous snapshot unchanged.
sourceAccess: Official ZIP download returned HTTP 200. Census HTML documentation/copyright pages returned HTTP 403 in this environment; no bypass was attempted. Source file contents and schema were inspected directly.
